comparison.objective: Identify a controller-released drive by its offset and replace it with a spare; candidate commissions a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Offset-based diagnosis plus drive extraction/insertion versus fine tool alignment, adjuster release/rotation/locking, and repeated impact evaluation.
comparison.success_condition: Drive offset and replacement thresholds are unavailable; candidate requires in-envelope physical cycles and retained collar setting.
comparison.reason: Module identification and replacement do not test energy-absorber tuning.
